title: Noisy hypercube edge weight
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Their noisy edge weight is their stable edge weight at correlation $1-2\delta$.
caveat: The underlying stable edge weight is defined using a correlated-pair probability mass function whose construction is not supplied.
